_about: Every persisted key. Per-TV keys are '<prefix>.<tvId>' and forgetting a TV removes all of them. Existing installs keep these: never rename a key, change a value shape, or 'unify' Android and iOS (they are separate local formats).

global.dpadTaps: bool, legacy: read only when 'layout' is missing, removed on the next layout change
global.companion.id: string, 12 hex digits, the stable _i for Apple TV

perTv.recents: JSON array (string) of up to 12 package names
perTv.launcher: bool, GoatLauncher seen on this TV (missing = unknown)
perTv.volumeUnknown: bool, HDMI-CEC: the TV doesn't report the volume

files.identity: filesDir/identity: int length + PKCS#8 RSA key + int length + certificate DER, written via identity.tmp

keychain.identity: RSA-2048 key, tag cc.slokker.goatremote.identity; certificate label GoatRemote; AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly
